• Director 5 – Independent Director (appointed 13 Nov 1993) | | **Recent Audits** | Audit Firm 1 – Unqualified opinion for FY 2022 and FY 2024 | ### Financial Highlights (RM) | Metric | FY 2022 | FY 2024 | |--------|--------|--------| | **Revenue** | 6.23 M | 6.52 M | | **Profit After Tax** | 265 k (4.26 % net margin) | 269 k (4.12 % net margin) | | **EBITDA** | 839 k (13.5 % margin) | 867 k (13.3 % margin) | | **Total Assets** | 5.57 M | 5.83 M | | **Total Equity** | 2.06 M | 2.48 M | | **Leverage Ratio** (Debt/Equity) | 1.70 | 1.35 | | **Interest Coverage** | 3.71× | 3.62× | | **Quick Ratio** | 1.36 | 1.72 | | **Operating Cash Flow** | 777 k | 602 k | | **Free Cash Flow** | 416 k | 283 k | ### Operational & Efficiency Indicators - **Gross profit margin** improved from 59.96 % (2022) to 61.99 % (2024). - **Operating expense ratio** fell from 52.3 % to 54.5 %, keeping operating profit margins around 7 %. - **Cash conversion cycle** lengthened from ~46 days to ~68 days, driven by higher days sales outstanding (75 → 92 days). - **Asset turnover** remained steady at ~1.12×, indicating efficient use of the asset base. ### Overall Assessment Everbright Teguh Hotel Sdn. Bhd. is a long‑standing, privately held boutique hotel with a stable ownership structure (dominant 90 % held by Director 4). The business generates modest but consistent revenue growth and maintains healthy profitability margins for the hospitality sector. Liquidity is solid (quick ratio > 1.3) and the company is comfortably covering interest obligations. The slight slowdown in cash conversion and a modest rise in leverage are the main areas to watch, but the firm’s equity base is growing and its financial position remains robust.
